using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class Evidence {Verified, Claimed}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(Evidence value)
inline std::optional<Evidence> parse_evidence(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(Evidence value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(Evidence value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, Evidence value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, Evidence value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kEvidenceNames
enum class ResourceCallOutcome {Ok, Forbidden, Unavailable, Invalid, Unknown}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(ResourceCallOutcome value)

inline constexpr bool operator==(ResourceCallOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(ResourceCallOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, ResourceCallOutcome value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, ResourceCallOutcome value)

inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, AcquireOutcome value)

struct Holder
  std::string program
  std::string account
  std::int64_t amount
  Evidence evidence
  std::string lease
  std::string grant
  std::string since
  std::string detail
struct ResourceState
  std::string resource
  std::int64_t capacity
  std::int64_t held
  std::vector<Holder> holders
  std::string observed
  std::string instrument
struct HoldersResult
  ResourceCallOutcome outcome
  std::optional<ResourceState> state
struct ResourceList
  std::vector<std::string> resources
  std::string observed
struct ResourcesResult
  ResourceCallOutcome outcome
  std::optional<ResourceList> list
struct Lease
  std::string id
  std::string resource
  std::int64_t amount
  std::string since
  std::string renew_by
struct YieldRecord
  std::string holder
  std::int64_t amount
  std::string answer
  std::int64_t took_ms
struct AcquireResult
  AcquireOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Lease> lease
  std::vector<YieldRecord> asked
struct YieldRequest
  std::string id
  std::string resource
  std::int64_t amount
  std::string reason
  std::string at
  std::string lease
struct YieldPage
  std::vector<YieldRequest> requests
  std::string next
struct ObserveResult
  ResourceCallOutcome outcome
  std::optional<YieldPage> page
struct AnswerResult
  bool recorded
struct AnswerCallResult
  ResourceCallOutcome outcome
  std::optional<AnswerResult> answer
struct LeaseChange
  bool applied
  std::optional<Lease> lease
struct LeaseChangeResult
  ResourceCallOutcome outcome
  std::optional<LeaseChange> change
struct ProcessBindResult
  ProcessBindOutcome outcome
inline std::string encode(const ResourceState& v)
inline ResourceState decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
inline std::string service_name(std::string_view frame)
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct Table
  virtual ResourcesResult resources()
  virtual HoldersResult holders(const std::string& resource, const bool& fresh)
template<class Transport>struct TableClient : Table
  Transport& transport_
  ResourcesResult resources() override
  HoldersResult holders(const std::string& resource, const bool& fresh) override
struct TableService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct TableDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Table& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct Leases
  virtual AcquireResult acquire(const std::string& resource, const std::int64_t& amount, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual LeaseChangeResult renew(const std::string& lease)
  virtual LeaseChangeResult release(const std::string& lease)
  virtual ObserveResult observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual AnswerCallResult answer(const std::string& request, const YieldAnswer& answer, const std::string& reason)
  virtual ProcessBindResult bind_process(const std::string& lease, const std::int64_t& pid)
template<class Transport>struct LeasesClient : Leases
  Transport& transport_
  AcquireResult acquire(const std::string& resource, const std::int64_t& amount, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  LeaseChangeResult renew(const std::string& lease) override
  LeaseChangeResult release(const std::string& lease) override
  ObserveResult observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  AnswerCallResult answer(const std::string& request, const YieldAnswer& answer, const std::string& reason) override
  ProcessBindResult bind_process(const std::string& lease, const std::int64_t& pid) override
struct LeasesService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct LeasesDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Leases& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
